name: S4d_last_attestor_key
description: The last active attestor key cannot be revoked (S4 D5, D9; amendment fix 1). On 11's prefix to its expect after the 2026Q3 report (#34), with attestor1 and attestor2 registered: attestor2 is revoked, so attestor1 is the last active key and its revocation is refused, each personality under its chain's name (Solana LastKeyOfKind, merces_registry lib.rs:242-245; EVM LastActiveKey, MercesRegistry.sol:333-335). Revoking attestor2 again is refused as a key that is not active (KeyAlreadyRevoked on Solana, KeyNotRegistered on the EVM). attestor2 is registered again (active, its revocation cleared), so attestor1 may now go; an extinguishment naming the revoked attestor1 is then refused (extinguishment needs active keys, no grace), and attestor2, alone again, cannot be revoked. Stage 1's reference simulator revokes with no last-key check (simulator.ts:535-546), so this runs on the merces backend only, not on the reference or in lockstep (DIV-S1I-2).

steps.note: two active keys: attestor2 may go, attestor1 is left
the last active attestor key: both chains refuse it, each under its own name
a key that is not active cannot be revoked again
re-registered: active again, its revocation cleared
two active keys again: attestor1 may go now (a rotation is this register then this revoke)
attestor1 is revoked: an extinguishment needs two active keys (no grace)
attestor2 is the last active key now
